clusters.name: copilot-readonly-guard
clusters.executionModeRationale: All four stories mutate or depend on the same wrapper (src/copilot-exec.mjs) plus shared plugin version manifests, AGENTS.md, and CHANGELOG.md in strict dependency order (helper -> wrapper guard -> callers -> docs/version). Parallelizing would produce conflicting writes to copilot-exec.mjs and the five version stamps, so the cluster must run serially.
